page.layout: One page of text, single column; running head at top; catchword-like signature "TRO-" at lower right of text block. No margin notes.

main_text.p: Studiosam vero iuuétutem, quæ cognoscendæ historiæ cupida est, hortor etiam atque etiam, vt auctorem hûc, qui multis nominibus cognitu iucûdissimus pariter est ac vtilissimus, ne postremo loco ducant, sed assidue diligenterque euoluant ad exemplum Augustini, Orosii, Isidori, aliorumque magni nominis virorum, qui frequenti cum lectione familiarem sibi reddiderunt adeo, vt multa ex illo, præsertim Orosius, ad verbum transscribere, suisque ipsorum scriptis inserere non dubitarint.
Cæterum cur mea hoc tempore scholia non in omnes, sed paucos duntaxat priores aliquot Iustini libros emittantur, causa non longe à principio lib. vndecimi indicata est.
Bene ac prosperè vale amice Lector, institutumque hoc nostrum in benigniorem, quæso, partem interpretare.

page.notes: Scan is a right-hand page with a torn/stained right edge. Faint marks in the lower part of the page are stains only. The line "TRO-" is a catchword at the foot of the text. Some letters are blurred by staining; "Præfatio" is set in small capitals. Spelling "Oro-fii" hyphenated at line end is printed as "Oro-sii" split; rendered as "Orosii".
